India Considers NEET Alternatives Amidst Fee Concerns

Discussions are underway in India regarding potential alternatives to the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) for medical admissions. The core concern revolves around preventing the reintroduction of capitation fees, a practice where institutions charge exorbitant sums for admission. Experts suggest that alternative admission frameworks could be designed to circumvent this issue. The focus is on finding a system that ensures merit-based admissions without allowing institutions to exploit students financially.
